snippet.title: Leap Of Faith Demo Trailer Gameplay
snippet.description: Unlimited local multiplayer chaos! Connect infinite controllers, control wobbly giraffes, dodge physics-based obstacles, and fight to reach the rocket ship first. The more players, the more chaos!
